verdict.rationale: WezTerm's config is plain Lua text (wezterm.lua) that lives in dotfiles, auto-reloads on change, and supports CLI overrides — and community evidence directly confirms this makes cross-machine syncing trivial ('it's just Lua code, easy to diff and easy to apply' vs. iTerm2 where syncing was 'next to impossible'). Missing for 10: no first-party doc explicitly discussing dotfiles/multi-machine sync workflows, only community corroboration.
